title: HD2 Mod Console
running: Game running · changes apply at once
not_running: Game not running · changes apply at the next launch
peek: Hide the window while changing a setting
peek_d: Only for the settings a mod marks for it. While one changes, the window keeps only its control, so you see the game take the change; it comes back 2.5 s after the last change or when you let go. Only while the game runs, in borderless windowed mode.
overlay_d: While the game runs, this key brings the window up over the game; pressing it again puts the window away and returns to the game. The window has to stay open (minimized is enough), and the game has to run in borderless windowed mode.
overlay_busy: Another program already uses this key. Choose another one.
reload_d: Read every mod's settings list and values again
auto_update_d: At start and every 6 hours. It only asks GitHub for the latest version number; nothing is downloaded.
about_d: Open source, MIT licence. Source code, releases and the notes for mod authors:
place_off_mod: {0} · not enabled: changes apply once it is enabled and deployed
profile_new: New profile from the current settings
profile_none: Save the current settings as a profile to switch back to them later.
profile_tip: Click to use it. Drag to reorder; right-click to rename, duplicate or delete.
confirm_delete: Delete the profile “{0}”? The mod's settings stay as they are.
confirm_all: Reset every setting of {0} to its default?
idle: Changes are sent to the game at once
saved_off: Saved {0} · applies at the next launch
owned: Set in the in-game Mod Options Menu
write_failed:
The settings could not be written:
{0}
empty_nav: Mods appear here once they hand over their settings
empty_title: There is nothing to set up here
empty_body: No folder needs to be chosen or made. A mod that supports this window hands its settings over by itself when the game starts, and they appear here. None has done so yet: the game has not started with such a mod.
s2d: The main menu is enough: the mod hands its settings over at launch
s3d: No need to reopen this window: the settings appear by themselves
mom_title: Mods you set in Mod Options Menu or Mod Bindings Menu
mom_body: Where these mods' settings show depends on the loader. With Boot Mod Loader they appear here once the game has started with it, with the values you set in Mod Options Menu; keys set in Mod Bindings Menu have to be set again. With another loader, such as MDL or Chef Shared Loader, they show in that loader's own in-game menu and, at present, not here.
watching: Waiting for a mod's settings; they load here by themselves
rescanned: Checked again: nothing yet · still waiting
plugin_summary: HD2 Mod Setting GUI's window: each mod's settings, with the enabled mods first and the mods that are off or not in the library listed apart.
